panels.title: Scheduled tasks (desktop local-agent) — daily context by model

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(m.ts, 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time, COALESCE(m.model, 'unknown') AS model, SUM(m.input_tokens + m.cache_create_tokens + m.cache_read_tokens) AS context FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = m.session_id WHERE s.entrypoint = 'local-agent' AND m.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND m.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND m.account IN (${account:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(m.ts, 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time, COALESCE(m.model, 'unknown') AS model, SUM(m.input_tokens + m.cache_create_tokens + m.cache_read_tokens) AS context FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = m.session_id WHERE s.entrypoint = 'local-agent' AND m.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND m.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND m.account IN (${account:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: SELECT first_ts, account, entrypoint, project_dir, models, calls, context_tokens, output_tokens, peak_context, ROUND(cache_hit_ratio, 3) AS cache_hit_ratio FROM v_session_totals WHERE first_ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND first_ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', $__to/1000, 'unixepoch') AND account IN (${account:sqlstring}) AND calls > 0 ORDER BY context_tokens DESC LIMIT 25
